answer: Every claim climbs the pearl of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the prism re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, reduced by each unverified claim, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. What survives to the lotus is a record of labour, not a list of addresses.
